title: Find an End city and get elytra

steps.title: Beat the dragon
steps.say: First defeat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon). A small gateway portal opens near the edge of the main island.

steps.title: Go through the gateway
steps.say: The gateway is a tiny portal floating in bedrock. Throw an [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl) into it to go through.

steps.title: Look for purple towers
steps.say: On the outer islands, look for tall purple towers. That is an [End city](place:end_city). Bring blocks to bridge between islands.

steps.title: Watch out for shulkers
steps.say: [Shulkers](mob:shulker) hide in boxes and shoot bullets that make you float up. Stay close to the ground, so the fall back down is short.

steps.title: Find the ship
steps.say: Some [End cities](place:end_city) have a ship floating nearby. The elytra hang in an [item frame](item:item_frame) at the back of the ship.

steps.title: Wear your wings
steps.say: Put the elytra on in your [chest](item:chest) armor slot.

steps.title: Fly!
steps.say: Jump off something high, then jump again in the air to glide. Use [firework rockets](item:firework_rocket) to fly faster and higher.
